To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) The problem of finding optimal registrations for a mobile in a cellular PCS system with overlapping registration areas is NP-Complete; (ii) A method is presented to find the optimal registration for a mobile in the deterministic version of the problem; (iii) A method is proposed to find the registration which minimises the expected number of future registrations in the stochastic version of the problem.
In summary, our research is concerned with
finding the optimal registration area for a user based on its mobility pattern, and the knowledge of the mobility patterns of other users in the system.

we present a method to determine the optimal registration for a mobile in a PCS system with overlapping Registration Areas.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the problem of finding optimal registrations can be solved efficiently and the solution can be implemented efficiently.
the problem of finding optimal registrations in a system with overlapping registration areas is non-trivial and can be modeled as a Markov Decision Process (MDP).
the problem of optimal registration in presence of overlapping RAs is a non-trivial one, and the methods presented in this paper can be used to solve this problem.
